summary: AgentApex UI fixes testing complete. All 8 features verified: 1) Property Edit shows pen icons for all 6 fields, 2) Property Edit has Photos/Documents/Videos sections with + buttons, 3) Interest Areas has floating + button at bottom right, 4) Interest Areas shows X/10 counter, 5) Interest Areas shows saved areas with toggle notifications and delete buttons, 6) MapSearch shows property type icons (🌾 for Land, 📐 for Plot) on markers, 7) Follow-ups form has Import from Phone Contacts option (code present, but API device-dependent - not visible in Playwright), 8) Notifications page loads at /agentapex/notifications with unread count and Mark all read.

issues: DialogContent accessibility warnings - Missing DialogTitle for screen readers

critical_code_review_comments: Follow-ups 'Import from Phone Contacts' button is correctly implemented but conditionally rendered with 'contacts' in navigator - only available on supported mobile devices
Vaul Drawer components trigger accessibility warnings about missing DialogTitle - consider adding VisuallyHidden title for screen reader support
